cues.en: Now that we are done with our utility functions to enable our API to send emails, we need to configure email sending.
cues.zh: 工具函式完成後，要讓 API 能寄送電子郵件，還需要設定寄信功能。

cues.en: To start us off, we're going to go to the core folder.
Then within the core folder we're going to create a new folder.
The folder is going to be emails like that.
Then within emails we're going to create some files.
cues.zh: 在 emails 裡建立幾個檔案。

cues.en: The first one being double underscore init double underscore dot pi, and the next one being tasks dot pi and config dot pi like that.
cues.zh: 第一個是 __init__.py，再來 tasks.py 與 config.py。

cues.en: So we should have backend up core emails, then init config tasks.
cues.zh: 所以是 backend/app/core/emails，裡面有 __init__、config 與 tasks。

cues.en: Then we're also going to add another folder where we're going to be storing our email templates.
cues.zh: 另外建立資料夾，存放電子郵件範本。

cues.en: So within emails we're going to create a new folder that's going to be templates like that.
cues.zh: 在 emails 裡新增 templates。

cues.en: So you can leave the templates folder empty.
For now we're going to get back to it.
Then after that let's start with the config dot pi file.
This file shall be used to configure email sending using the fastapi email package that we had installed some time ago.
cues.zh: 這個檔案會透過之前安裝的 fastapi-mail 套件，設定電子郵件寄送。

cues.en: As usual, we start with our imports.
As you can see from our fast API mail, we're going to import a fast mail and connection config.
cues.zh: 從 fastapi_mail 匯入 FastMail 與 ConnectionConfig。

cues.en: Then from Pydantic we're going to import a secret string.
Then from Pathlib you're going to import path, then from backend.app.co dot config.
cues.zh: 從 pathlib 匯入 Path，再從 backend.app.core.config，

cues.en: Again to import a settings like that.
Then first we're going to get the absolute path to the templates folder.
cues.zh: 首先取得 templates 資料夾的絕對路徑。

cues.en: And the templates folder I'm talking about is the one that you've created within the emails directory.
cues.zh: 就是剛才在 emails 目錄建立的 templates。

cues.en: So how do you do that.
We can have a variable called templates underscore directory.
And that's going to be path then double underscore file.
Then we're going to move up one directory.
Then we're going to reference the current directory which is emails.
cues.zh: 也就是目前所在的 emails 目錄。

cues.en: So you say dot parent.
Then the templates are going to be on slash.
Then in double quotation marks templates like that.
Then after declaring the path to the templates directory we can now configure Fastmail.
cues.zh: 範本目錄路徑定義好後，設定 FastMail。

cues.en: So I can say email config.
That's going to be connection config.
Then we're going to add some configuration settings.
So the first one is going to be mail from.
And that's going to be settings dot mail from.
And this mail from is the email address from which the emails are going to be sent.
cues.zh: MAIL_FROM 是寄出電子郵件所用的寄件地址。

cues.en: Then we're going to have mail underscore from name.
And that is the name of the email address from which the emails will be sent.
And that's going to be settings dot mail from name.
Then we're going to declare the port of the SMTP server by saying mail underscore port.
cues.zh: 接著用 MAIL_PORT 指定 SMTP 伺服器連接埠。

cues.en: That's going to be settings dot SMTP port like that.
Then the next one is going to be the host of the SMTP server.
cues.zh: 下一個是 SMTP 伺服器主機。

cues.en: As you can see mail underscore server.
And that's going to be settings dot SMTP host like that.
Then the username of the SMTP server.
cues.zh: 接著 SMTP 伺服器使用者名稱，

cues.en: So you can say mail username.
That's going to be an empty string.
Then the password of the SMTP server as you can see mail password.
cues.zh: 再來是 SMTP 密碼，也就是 MAIL_PASSWORD。

cues.en: That's going to be we're going to use the secret string and then just pass in empty strings like that.
Then you're going to configure whether to use SSL or TLS encryption.
cues.zh: 接著設定是否使用 SSL 或 TLS 加密。

cues.en: And since we're using mail for development we don't need SSL encryption.
cues.zh: 因為是開發用 Mailpit，不需要 SSL 加密。

cues.en: So you can say mail underscore SSL TLS.
You can set that to false.
Then we're going to configure weather to start using TLS encryption.
So you can say Mel underscore start TLS.
We're going to set that to false.
Then whether to use our credentials.
cues.zh: 接著是否使用認證資訊。

cues.en: So you can say use credentials.
We're going to set that to false.
Then whether to validate our certificates.
As you can see validate certificates.
We're going to set that to false since we're in development.
cues.zh: 因為是開發環境，設為 False。

cues.en: Then the folder where the email templates are going to be stored.
cues.zh: 再指定電子郵件範本所在的資料夾。

cues.en: As you can see the template folder that's going to be the templates directory that we defined up above.
cues.zh: TEMPLATE_FOLDER 就是上面定義的 TEMPLATES_DIR。

cues.en: Then after that we can now initialize our first mail by saying first mail.
cues.zh: 接著初始化 FastMail，命名為 fast_mail。

cues.en: That's going to be a first mail.
Then pass in the email configuration like that.
Then you can save the file.
Good.
That's it for the email configuration.
cues.zh: 電子郵件設定就完成了。

cues.en: If you want to read more or explore other settings, you can go to the documentation of our Fast Mail, which is on this link.
cues.zh: 若想了解更多設定，可以前往 FastMail 文件，就在這個連結。

cues.en: Then getting started, you're going to see the configuration settings, some of which we have used, others I didn't, so you can read through and explore more.
cues.zh: 到 Getting started，可以看到組態設定；有些我們用到了，有些沒用，可以自行閱讀探索。

cues.en: Then you can also look at some examples like that.
That's it for this lecture.
In the next lecture we're going to be configuring our celery tasks.
cues.zh: 下一堂課設定 Celery 工作。
